architecture.mechanism: Deep-learning-based object detection of structural defects such as spalling, cracks, and pitted surfaces to map deterioration in overhead panels
architecture.intervention: Apply a deep-neural-network-based object detection algorithm trained on images of vehicle headliner and console mounting surfaces to identify structural defects (cracks, spalling, pitted surfaces) that cause fastener failure, then reinforce only the verified defect zones with compatible adhesive-backed mounting brackets positioned outside the dash camera installation footprint
architecture.expected_effect: The overhead console remains securely attached by anchoring to structurally sound substrate regions identified by the detection algorithm, eliminating detachment while preserving the designated dash camera mounting area
architecture.falsification_test: Mount the overhead console using the defect-mapped reinforcement brackets, install a dash camera in its intended location, and subject the assembly to 10G multi-axis vibration per SAE J2345; failure occurs if the console detaches or if any bracket obstructs the dash camera field of view or mounting interface
